mechanism: True ring digits admit generating-function F3 polynomials with degree bounds2*3^j. At M>n*(3^d-1), Chevalley-Warning makes every low-frequency fiber divisible by3. A complete LOW-ROW-DEPENDENT triple partition would extract one qutrit at q/3^d with no postselection. Pointed unit minors and independent high lifts prove two independent uniform child frequency rows. At d=r-1, the required batch is n*(q/3-1)+1, polynomial when q=poly(n), but efficient coherent partitioning is NOT implemented.
research_decision: Keep exact lexicographic grouping as an exponential reference: a worst-case efficient basis compiler for it would compute 3-CNF model counts modulo3. Seek a NONLEXICOGRAPHIC, IID-average or source-state-specific low-row-dependent compiler, or a charged constant-coverage substitute. Existence and frequency evaluation do not provide it.
falsifiers: A true native digit disagrees with its generating-function polynomial or exceeds the degree bound.
A nonempty above-threshold fiber has cardinality not divisible by3.
A complete instrument drops or duplicates original basis words or retains word-index garbage.
A selected pointed minor is nonunit, or tag selection conditions the high lifts.
One consumed batch is counted as every possible child tag, or an exponential reference is called efficient.

proof_obligations.PO-REVIEW: Independently review true digit degrees, the strict Chevalley-Warning threshold, complete triple map and high-lift conditional law.
proof_obligations.PO-INPUT: Use clean fresh original even-native qutrits with two IID uniform full frequency rows and an integer secret in Z_q^n. Do not extend this model to arbitrary cyclotomic-algebra secrets or other label laws.
proof_obligations.PO-COMPILER: The decisive missing capability is an efficient coherent LOW-row-dependent fiber partition with clean forward/inverse access. Rank, unrank, count, tables and QRAM loading costs must be charged IF used, but global ranking and compressed tags are NOT required: a costed low-only nonlinear three-cycle action is a sufficient alternative. Its efficient evaluation and adequate moved mass remain missing.
proof_obligations.PO-LEX: The supplied exact lexicographic map has an explicit worst-case counting reduction at prefix9/parent27. Do not misapply this obstruction to a different partition, IID average-case labels or approximation only on actual source states.
proof_obligations.PO-ALGEBRA: Digit equations contain mixed-variable carries and degrees growing with3^d. Constant-degree diagonal-equation solvers are not supplied. Generic PPA_p completeness does not prove this structured system hard.
proof_obligations.PO-OUTPUT: Each actual tag has Born mass3^(1-M) independent of every secret and high label. Exactly one child is returned per M-input batch. Its IID pair law is a population conditioning theorem, not a fixed-batch empirical histogram.
proof_obligations.PO-SUPPLY: At d=r-1 the source cost is n*(q/3-1)+1 per child. This is polynomial in n when q=poly(n), not polynomial in logq alone. Actual upstream source caps still apply.
proof_obligations.PO-DECODER: Compose with a costed field-root learner and known-low-digit correction only after the compiler is available. No full-secret solver is currently supplied.
proof_obligations.PO-NOISE: Approximate input and approximate compilation require a whole-batch trace-error ledger. Marginal error bounds alone do not certify joint coherence.
proof_obligations.PO-FRESH: Distinct outputs require fresh independent parent batches. Unique IDs do not by themselves prove source independence.
proof_obligations.PO-NOVELTY: No new fast algorithm, new existence principle, general quantum lower bound or LWE attack is claimed. Novelty is unreviewed.
